executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most pressured areas. The Daily Check of 2026-09-04 reviewed eight relevant current reports; it finds no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with delay. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
